name: King Up
summary: Players secretly back six characters and maneuver all 13 up a castle, voting to crown or eliminate king candidates.
rules_text: Each game has three rounds. At start of a round, deal each player a secret goal showing six favored characters. Players in turn order place characters onto floors 0 to 4 of the castle, at most four per floor. Leftovers go to floor 0. Then players take turns moving any character up one floor if destination has fewer than four. Moving from floor 5 to the throne triggers an election. All players simultaneously vote Yes or No: Yes cards are unlimited, No cards are limited and discarded when used, and hand sizes are secret. If all Yes, that character is king and round ends. If any No, the character is eliminated from the round and play continues left of the crown holder. At round end, players reveal goals and score by final heights: throne 10, floor 5 is 5, 4 is 4, 3 is 3, 2 is 2, 1 is 1, 0 is 0, eliminated 0. In round three, a zero becomes 33. Highest total after three rounds wins.
rating_reason: Card-play intrigue to advance heir, hidden hands and bluffing
